outcomes.obj: a governed environment in which a fleet of coding agents does useful engineering work at bounded risk
outcomes.statement: After the book, the reader can design a governed engineering environment in which a fleet of coding agents produces correct work at bounded risk — choosing the right mechanism, the right model, and the right transformation for each failure class.
outcomes.anchor: Preface 'Who this book is for': recognize when an engineering problem is being paid for repeatedly in reconstruction or human judgment; decide whether a better representation, stronger authority, or both would retire that cost; and design mechanisms suited to your own system rather than copying another organization's process.
